terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI strategy API on http://localhost:8000 (docs at /docs, health at /health).

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Next.js dev server on http://localhost:3000 (reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL from frontend/.env.local).
